relations.text: 電池合弁NextStarから撤退を決定(16億ユーロの損失計上)
relations.text_en: Decided to exit the NextStar battery JV (€1.6bn loss recognized)

source.label: Stellantis 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: €1.6 billion recognized within Gains/(losses) on disposal of investments, relating to the decision to exit the Company's battery joint venture with LG Energy Solution, NextStar Energy Inc. ("NextStar").

relations.text: 中国国外でLeapmotor車を販売する合弁(ステランティス51%)
relations.text_en: JV selling Leapmotor cars outside China (Stellantis 51%)

source.label: Stellantis 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Leapmotor International, is a jointly established, Stellantis‐controlled company created in 2024 and owned 51 percent by Stellantis and 49 percent by Leapmotor, to distribute Leapmotor‐branded vehicles outside of China ("LPMI").

companies.name: クレディ・アグリコル

relations.text: リース合弁Leasysを50%ずつ保有
relations.text_en: Holds the Leasys leasing joint venture 50/50

source.label: Stellantis 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The Stellantis leasing and financing activities are structured through the following partnerships: (i) Leasys, a 50 percent held joint venture with Crédit Agricole Consumer Finance & Mobility dedicated to pan- European multi-brand long-term operational leasing activities; (ii) A partnership between Stellantis Financial Services Europe ("SFSE"), and BNP Paribas Personal Finance ("BNPP PF")
